intel.title: [CISA KEV] TrueConf Server - TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-72530
廠商: TrueConf
產品: Server
漏洞名稱: TrueConf Server Code Injection Vulnerability
說明: TrueConf Server contains a code injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthorized remote attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to use a specially crafted script to break out of the isolated environment and execute arbitrary code on the host system.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-09-03
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: TrueConf Server 存在代碼注入漏洞（CVE-2026-72530），遠端攻擊者可透過 4307/TCP 連接埠發送惡意腳本，繞過隔離環境並在主機上執行任意程式碼。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），具備極高危害性。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] TrueConf Server - TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-72529
廠商: TrueConf
產品: Server
漏洞名稱: TrueConf Server Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
說明: TrueConf Server contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which could allow a remote unauthorized attacker with network access via port 4307/TCP to execute an arbitrary script.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-23
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: TrueConf Server 存在關鍵功能缺失身分驗證之漏洞（CVE-2026-72529），遠端未授權的攻擊者可透過 4307/TCP 埠執行任意腳本。此漏洞已被列入 CISA KEV 漏洞名單，代表已有在野利用，但因本公司無此資產，故無直接影響。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
